user.title: How should Home Assistant reach the printer?

cloud.title: Anycubic account
cloud.description: Paste the access token from Anycubic Slicer Next (or the whole configuration file section that holds it). Home Assistant signs in with it; it never asks for your password.

data_description.user_token: The token, or text that contains it. Quotes and surrounding configuration text are removed.
data_description.user_device_id: Only for a token taken from the Android app. Leave empty otherwise.
data_description.region: The Anycubic service your account belongs to. Accounts are not shared between the two.

printer.title: Choose printers
printer.description: Pick the printers on your Anycubic account that this entry should cover.

local.title: Printer in LAN Mode
local.description: Switch LAN Mode on at the printer first (Settings → Network → LAN Mode). The printer then works without the Anycubic cloud.

data_description.lan_host: The printer's address on your network, for example 192.168.1.50. You find it on the printer under Settings → Network.

confirm_discovery.title: Anycubic printer found
confirm_discovery.description: An Anycubic printer was found at {host}. Do you want to set it up?

reauth_or_choose_printer.title: What do you want to change?

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: Change how Home Assistant reaches the printer.

data_description.lan_mode_enabled: Talk to the printer directly on your network. LAN Mode must also be switched on at the printer.
data_description.lan_host: The printer's address on your network, for example 192.168.1.50. You find it on the printer under Settings → Network.

error.lan_host_required: Enter the printer's IP address or host name.
error.lan_printer_in_cloud_mode: The printer answered, but LAN Mode is off. On the printer, open Settings → Network and switch LAN Mode on, then try again.
error.lan_unsupported_printer: The printer answered with something this integration cannot use. Older models (Kobra 2 and earlier) have no LAN Mode.
error.lan_unreachable: No printer answered at this address. Check that the printer is switched on, awake and on the same network.
error.lan_different_printer: A different printer answered at this address. To add another printer, set up a new entry instead.
error.invalid_token_format: No token was found in what you pasted.
error.token_expired: This token has expired. Sign in to Anycubic Slicer Next again and copy the new one.
error.token_corrupted: This token is damaged: its signature does not match. Copy it again, in full.
error.invalid_auth: Anycubic did not accept this token.
error.wrong_token_type: This is not an access token. Copy the access token from Anycubic Slicer Next.
error.cannot_read_response: Anycubic answered with something this integration could not read. This is a fault in the integration; please report it with your printer model and firmware.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Anycubic cloud. Try again in a moment.
error.no_printers: Choose at least one printer. If the list is empty, the account has no printers - a printer in LAN Mode leaves the account.
error.invalid_printer: Anycubic could not give the details of a chosen printer. A printer in LAN Mode leaves the account.

abort.already_configured: This printer is already set up. If its address changed, the entry now uses the new one.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The settings were saved and the printer reconnected.
abort.cloud_credentials_unavailable: The Anycubic app credentials this integration needs could not be loaded, so Anycubic accounts cannot be used right now. See the repair notice for details.
abort.reauth_successful: The new token was saved and the entry restarted.
abort.wrong_account: This token belongs to a different Anycubic account than the entry.

mqtt.title: Cloud connection
mqtt.description: When to keep the live connection to the Anycubic cloud open. Used by cloud entries.

drying.title: Drying presets
drying.description: Up to four fixed drying programmes for the ACE. Each complete preset gets its own start button.

data_description.drying_preset_duration_1: How long preset 1 dries for. Set both values of a preset to get a button for it.
data_description.drying_preset_duration_2: How long preset 2 dries for. Set both values of a preset to get a button for it.
data_description.drying_preset_duration_3: How long preset 3 dries for. Set both values of a preset to get a button for it.
data_description.drying_preset_duration_4: How long preset 4 dries for. Set both values of a preset to get a button for it.

card_config.title: Side panel card

cloud_credentials_unavailable.title: Anycubic cloud features are unavailable
cloud_credentials_unavailable.description: The Anycubic app credentials are read at run time from the {package} Python package, which could not be loaded or is incomplete. Printers in LAN Mode keep working; entries that need the Anycubic cloud wait until it is available. Your entries and their settings are unchanged. Reinstalling the integration, then restarting Home Assistant, usually fixes this.

token_expiring.title: The Anycubic token of {name} expires soon
token_expiring.description: The token {name} uses expires in {days} days. Anycubic tokens last about 90 days and cannot be renewed automatically. Copy a fresh token (helpers: [macOS]({tool_macos}), [Windows]({tool_windows}), [browser]({tool_browser})) and enter it with [re-authentication]({reauth_url}).

lan_mode_off.message: LAN Mode is switched off for this entry. Switch it on in the entry's options.

lan_mode_disabled.message: The printer answered, but LAN Mode is off at the printer.

lan_unsupported_printer.message: The printer's reply cannot be used by this integration.

lan_connection_lost.message: The printer at {host} does not answer.

printer_printing.message: Not possible while a print is running.

cloud_only_control.message: This can only be done through the Anycubic cloud, which cannot reach a printer in LAN Mode.

cloud_only_action.message: The action {action} needs the Anycubic cloud, which a printer in LAN Mode cannot use.

speed_mode_unavailable.message: This speed mode is not one the printer offers for the job. Over LAN the printer lists no speed modes.

job_not_in_progress.message: The print job is not running.

config_entry_not_found.message: No Anycubic entry with this ID exists.

config_entry_not_loaded.message: The Anycubic entry is not loaded.

one_printer_at_a_time.message: Choose one printer device at a time.

printer_not_found.message: The printer was not found in this entry.

gcode_read_failed.message: The uploaded file could not be read.

mqtt_connect_timeout.message: The live connection to the Anycubic cloud could not be opened. Try switching on the manual MQTT connection, then try again.

file_list_unavailable.message: The {source} file list cannot be fetched over this printer's current connection.

cloud_credentials_unavailable.message: The Anycubic app credentials could not be loaded, so this entry cannot reach the Anycubic cloud yet. Its settings are kept.

no_token.message: This entry has no Anycubic token.

token_rejected.message: Anycubic no longer accepts this entry's token.

cloud_read_error.message: Anycubic answered with something this integration could not read. This is a fault in the integration; please report it with your printer model and firmware.

cloud_unavailable.message: The Anycubic cloud is not answering: {error}

cloud_not_available.message: The Anycubic cloud is not available for this printer.

printer_not_in_cloud.message: The Anycubic cloud cannot supply a printer of this entry. A printer in LAN Mode leaves the Anycubic account: to use it that way, switch LAN Mode on in the entry's options and enter the printer's address.

printer_removed.message: The Anycubic cloud reports this printer removed from the account, which LAN Mode does.

cloud_error.message: The Anycubic cloud refused the request: {message}

cloud_file_delete_failed.message: The Anycubic cloud did not delete the file.

cloud_storage_full.message: There is not enough free space in the Anycubic cloud storage for this file.

slots_required.message: This printer has an ACE: give one slot per colour of the file.

slots_not_allowed.message: This printer has no ACE: leave the slots out.

slot_not_on_ace.message: A chosen slot is not on a connected ACE (slots 1-4 are on the first ACE, 5-8 on the second).

slot_mapping_failed.message: The slots do not fit the file: {message}
